quotes.text: Bug 1896844 moved browser_import.js from directly opening calendar-ics-file-dialog.xhtml to invoking calendar_import_command, using MockFilePicker, waiting for the about:import tab, checking pane transitions, filtering, target calendar selection, import completion, and the resulting calendar items. This covers the real command path and the consolidated wizard. Use named browser tests and observable pane/data checks when moving a flow, then remove obsolete dialog resources in the same change stack.
